foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat $50.00 nonrefundable filing fee stated on Form FLLC-1 (rev. 11/2025).
foreignQualification.formName: Application for Certificate of Authority for Foreign Limited Liability Company (Form FLLC-1)
foreignQualification.filedWith: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs (DCCA), Business Registration Division
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File annual business reports with BREG (online $12.50) and continuously maintain a registered agent in Hawaii.

evidence.quote: Application for Certificate of Authority for Foreign Limited Liability Company
State of Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs Business Registration Division
The company shall have and continuously maintain in the State of Hawaii, a registered agent who shall have a business address in this State.
The state of Hawaiʻi Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs (DCCA) Business Registration Division (BREG) reminds businesses to file their annual business reports.
Fees for filing Hawaiʻi annual business reports online are as follows: LLCs, profit corporations and LLPs: $12.50

notes: The $50 figure is the nonrefundable filing fee stated on the current Form FLLC-1 (rev. 11/2025); the earlier /breg/files/2015/12/fllc-1.pdf URL now redirects to this wp-content path, so the final URL is cited. The annual report obligation and its $12.50 online fee come from BREG's own annual-report release; root states.json carries the same $12.50 figure.
